atoms.text: Nowadays, aeroplanes are a lot bigger and a lot louder. Select the button 'Aeroplane Sound' to hear what they sound like.
atoms.sound: ssml: Nowadays, aeroplanes are a lot bigger and a lot louder. Select the button 'Aeroplane Sound' to hear what they sound like.

example.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom' gain='1'>Large Airplane Jet</voice>

atoms.text: One of today’s largest aeroplanes can carry up to 555 passengers, up to 3,000 suitcases and its wingspan is over 80 metres long. That means compared to the Wright brothers’ aeroplane, this aeroplane is 6.5 times wider.

text: Wingspan is the distance between the outer tips of the wings of an aeroplane or a bird.
hint.label: Wingspan

instruction.text: What information does the timeline show you?

b: It shows that aeroplanes have got smaller and lighter.
++It shows when different kinds of aeroplanes were invented from 1900 to today.
It shows how much aeroplanes cost.

instruction.text: Drag the pictures into the correct order from the oldest to the newest version of an aeroplane.
Match the aeroplane to its sound.

hint.text: Remember, one aeroplane flew like a kite on the wind and glided through the air. The newer version of that was powered by a propeller engine. Modern aeroplanes are the loudest.
